rawContent: @CMPD Thank you Wendy Kerl for your service. Thank you CMPD and all officers for what you do and keeping us safe. I knew, some would see what they wanted to see and spin it. Just remember, obey commands, don't delay, and don't resist. #BlueLivesMatter #cmpd
